description: Two manual trigger buttons, each with a display showing a name picked from a built-in list, so the patch says what the button is wired to

params.text: Chooses that row's name from a list of 37 words, MUTE, RESET and KICK among them
Sends a trigger from that row's output

inputs.text: A trigger here fires that row's output without the button being pressed

outputs.text: A 10V trigger each time that row's button is pressed or its EXT input is triggered

notes: The word on the display is a label and nothing else; it changes neither the trigger nor the output.

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
